title: Bump @deepseek-ai/schemastery to 3.18.4 in the dsh integration
summary: A dependency-only change: the `dsh` integration's devDependency on `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` moves from 3.18.2 to 3.18.4, and the pnpm lockfile is regenerated to match — a new package entry, a new snapshot, and the importer specifier/version pair updated. No source code changes, so the runtime shape of the system is untouched; what changes is which schema-validation build the dsh integration resolves at install time.
